en:
Before using this game, please read and agree to the Privacy Policy.

This game stores progress and settings locally. To meet real-name verification and minor anti-addiction requirements, the game integrates TapSDK from XD (Shanghai) Network Technology Co., Ltd. TapSDK may process your TapTap account identifier, authentication status, age range, AndroidID, device model, system version, network type and network status. If manual real-name verification is selected, TapTap may process your real name and identity document number. The game operator does not locally retain your complete identity document number.

TapSDK Privacy Policy: [url=https://developer.taptap.cn/docs/sdk/start/agreement/]View official policy[/url]
zh:
使用本游戏前，请阅读并同意隐私政策。
